supported_commands.programmatic: from run_agent import AIAgent; agent = AIAgent(base_url=..., api_key=..., provider=...)

provider_config.mechanism: ProviderProfile objects registered via register_provider() in plugins/model-providers/<name>/__init__.py
provider_config.openai_compatible: Use provider='custom' or provider name matching a plugin

supported_commands.installation: pip install -e .  or  uv pip install -e '.[all,dev]'
supported_commands.skill_discovery: Scans skills/, ~/.hermes/skills/, and --skills-dir arg; loaded via agent/skill_*.py

skill_discovery_mechanism.loading: agent/skill_commands.py: scan directories for SKILL.md files and .py tools
skill_discovery_mechanism.registration: Skills registered into agent's internal registry, exposed as slash commands and system prompt additions

openai_compatible_provider_config.env_vars: None fixed — uses base_url from config, api_key from config
openai_compatible_provider_config.base_url: User-configured (typically LLM_BASE_URL or configured in model.base_url)
openai_compatible_provider_config.key_env_var: OPENAI_API_KEY or per-provider key in config.yaml
openai_compatible_provider_config.note: For NVIDIA NIM specifically: NVIDIA_API_KEY env var, base_url=https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1

blockers: Cannot import Hermes directly without installation (pip install -e .)
AIAgent instantiation requires available provider and model configuration
Skill loading requires skill directories with SKILL.md files
